title: Rise Headline
summary: Headline lines slide up out of a clip as the section scrolls into view.
useWhen: editorial article headline that reveals as the reader scrolls

whyItWorks.how: Each line sits in an overflow hidden parent and its child translates by its own height.
Lines start 60ms apart so the eye reads top to bottom.
The entrance uses an ease-out curve so the text lands softly.

directions.name: Quiet
directions.change: Shorten --rise-duration to 400ms and remove the stagger.

directions.name: Dramatic
directions.change: Raise --rise-stagger to 80ms and add a third line.

pitfalls: Stagger longer than 400ms in total makes the last line feel late.

tunables.name: --rise-duration
tunables.effect: Time each line takes to rise.

reducedMotion: The lines are visible at once with no movement.
